one_line_description: Salesforce is a comprehensive cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) platform that helps businesses manage sales, marketing, and customer service operations.
self_serve_details: Free lifetime Salesforce Developer Edition account provides instant access to APIs and developer environments.
api_surface: Broad suite of APIs including REST, SOAP, GraphQL, Bulk, and Pub/Sub (gRPC) APIs covering thousands of endpoints.
additional_notes: Salesforce provides robust developer environments with extensive toolkits. Be mindful of API daily transaction limits.

one_line_description: HubSpot is an inbound marketing, sales, and service platform that helps companies attract visitors, convert leads, and close customers.
self_serve_details: Free developer accounts and sandbox environments can be created instantly to test APIs and build integrations.
api_surface: Broad REST API with hundreds of endpoints covering CRM, CMS, Marketing, and Webhooks, with emerging GraphQL support.
additional_notes: Legacy 'hapikey' API keys were fully deprecated in November 2022. All developers must use OAuth 2.0 or Private App Access Tokens.

one_line_description: Pipedrive is a web-based sales CRM designed to help businesses plan sales activities and monitor deals.
self_serve_details: Free developer sandbox account available instantly to test and build apps.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering Deals, Activities, Users, and Leads, alongside a robust Webhooks system.
additional_notes: Pipedrive provides an excellent Developer Center with interactive API references, client libraries, and a fully functional sandbox environment.

one_line_description: Attio is a highly customizable, data-driven CRM designed for modern, fast-growing teams.
self_serve_details: Free workspace tier allows developers to instantly generate API keys and register OAuth applications.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API covering workspaces, records, attributes, and relationships, paired with Webhooks.
additional_notes: Attio features a highly flexible schema with fully customizable objects and attributes, making its API exceptionally clean.

one_line_description: An open-source, highly customizable modern CRM designed as an alternative to Salesforce.
self_serve_details: Free cloud tier and open-source self-hosting allow instant access to API key generation in settings.
api_surface: Broad REST and GraphQL APIs with Webhooks for real-time events.
additional_notes: Extremely developer-friendly due to its open-source nature. Features a dual REST/GraphQL API setup.

one_line_description: A highly customizable collaborative work management and CRM platform that enables teams to build custom applications and automate workflows.
self_serve_details: Anyone with a Podio account can instantly generate API keys (Client ID and Client Secret) for free via settings.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering workspaces, items, applications, users, and tasks, alongside Webhooks.
additional_notes: Podio features a unique 'App authentication' mechanism using an App ID and App Token, bypassing the need for user-level OAuth.

one_line_description: Zoho CRM is a cloud-based customer relationship management platform that helps businesses manage sales, marketing, and support.
self_serve_details: Zoho Developer Console is free to register and generates OAuth credentials instantly.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering leads, contacts, deals, webhooks, and custom modules.
additional_notes: Requires multi-datacenter routing support (US, EU, IN, AU, CN) as Zoho accounts are siloed by region.

one_line_description: Close is a sales engagement CRM designed to help SMB teams close more deals, faster, through integrated calling and emailing.
self_serve_details: Free 14-day trial provides instant API key generation in settings.
api_surface: Robust REST API covering leads, contacts, activities, and tasks, alongside Webhooks.
additional_notes: API keys are passed as the username in Basic Auth with an empty password. Highly reliable.

one_line_description: Copper is a CRM designed specifically for Google Workspace users to manage leads, opportunities, and communications.
self_serve_details: API keys can be generated by account administrators in Settings > Integrations > API Keys.
api_surface: REST API covering leads, activities, opportunities, and custom fields.
additional_notes: Requires custom headers `X-Pw-AccessToken` and `X-Pw-UserEmail` for authentication rather than Bearer Token.

one_line_description: DealCloud is a specialized CRM and deal management platform designed for capital markets, private equity, and investment banking teams.
self_serve_details: API access requires an active enterprise subscription and administrator activation.
api_surface: REST API for deal tracking, contacts, and custom objects, with detailed reference docs.
buildability_blockers: Requires paid corporate account and admin setup to generate developer credentials.
additional_notes: Gated enterprise tool with no free self-serve developer tier.

one_line_description: Zendesk is a customer service software company that provides support, sales, and customer engagement platform services.
self_serve_details: Free developer account sandbox can be requested through Zendesk Developer Program.
api_surface: Extremely broad REST API covering tickets, users, organizations, Help Center (Guide), and Chat.
additional_notes: Supports Basic Authentication with `/token` appended to the email address, which is highly convenient for single-account agents.

one_line_description: Intercom is a customer communications platform that helps businesses connect with customers through messaging, bots, and help desks.
self_serve_details: Free Developer Workspace can be created instantly to build private apps or OAuth integrations.
api_surface: Broad REST API for contacts, conversations, articles, admin users, and custom data attributes.
additional_notes: Developer workspaces have access to full API capabilities for free. Supports Webhooks with HMAC validation.

one_line_description: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support software that helps businesses resolve queries across email, phone, and chat.
self_serve_details: Free 14-day trial provides immediate access to API key in profile settings.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering tickets, contacts, agents, groups, and articles.
additional_notes: API key is used as the username in Basic Auth with any dummy password (e.g. 'X').

one_line_description: Front is a customer communication hub that surrounds email, chat, and SMS channels with internal team collaboration tools.
self_serve_details: Free developer sandbox environment can be requested online.
api_surface: REST API covering messages, analytics, inboxes, contacts, and teammates, plus Webhooks.
additional_notes: Front provides high-quality developer resources and a fully functional sandboxing flow.

one_line_description: Pylon is a customer support platform designed specifically to manage external customer communications inside Slack, Discord, and Teams.
self_serve_details: Requires contacting sales or signing up for a paid corporate account to request API access.
api_surface: REST API for managing customer channels, accounts, messages, and sync statuses.
buildability_blockers: Requires enterprise sign-up and custom admin approval to obtain API tokens.
additional_notes: Mainly focused on Slack integrations. No self-serve public developer sign-up.

one_line_description: LiveAgent is a help desk software that aggregates customer queries from emails, chats, calls, and social media into a single ticketing panel.
self_serve_details: Free 14-day trial provides instant API key creation in configuration settings.
api_surface: REST API for ticket management, agent profiles, chat logs, and custom fields.
additional_notes: Allows simple API key authentication via `apikey` query parameter or `apikey` header.

one_line_description: Plain is an API-first support platform designed to help engineering teams build support workflows and interfaces into their own apps.
self_serve_details: Free developer tier allows instant generation of API keys inside the Plain workspace.
api_surface: Modern GraphQL API covering customers, threads, timeline events, and labels.
additional_notes: GraphQL-first support system designed for high developer ergonomics.

one_line_description: Help Scout is a customer support software platform that provides shared inboxes, knowledge bases, and live chat widgets.
self_serve_details: Free developer account can be requested to build apps and test APIs.
api_surface: Broad REST API (v2) covering mailboxes, conversations, users, and Docs (KB), plus Webhooks.
additional_notes: Deprecated legacy API keys. Requires standard OAuth2 client credentials flow or authorization code flow.

one_line_description: Gorgias is an ecommerce-focused helpdesk that integrates directly with Shopify, Magento, and BigCommerce.
self_serve_details: Free 7-day trial provides instant API key configuration under Settings > Rest API.
api_surface: REST API covering tickets, messages, orders, customers, and events.
additional_notes: Uses standard HTTP Basic auth with user email and API key.

one_line_description: Gladly is a customer service platform centered around people instead of tickets, providing single-stream customer history.
self_serve_details: Requires an active enterprise subscription; API credentials must be generated by administrators.
api_surface: REST API covering profiles, conversations, transactions, and custom data entities.
buildability_blockers: No free self-serve developer tier; requires a paid Gladly customer instance.
additional_notes: Enterprise helpdesk software. Basic auth with token is standard.

one_line_description: Slack is a cloud-based team collaboration platform that offers messaging, file sharing, and app integrations.
self_serve_details: Free developer workspaces can be created instantly to build and test custom Slack apps.
api_surface: Extremely broad Web API (REST), Events API (Webhooks), and Socket Mode for firewall-friendly connections.
additional_notes: Highly mature developer platform. Socket Mode is excellent for running local agent servers without exposing ports.

one_line_description: Twilio is a developer platform for communications, offering APIs for SMS, voice calls, video, and verification.
self_serve_details: Free trial account with trial credits is available instantly on signup.
api_surface: Extremely broad REST API, helper libraries in multiple languages, and a Webhooks ecosystem.
additional_notes: Uses Account SID and Auth Token as Basic Auth credentials. Verification of phone numbers is required for trial accounts.

one_line_description: Zoho Cliq is a team communication software that offers chat channels, file sharing, and automated bots.
self_serve_details: Free developer account registration via Zoho Developer Console.
api_surface: REST API covering channels, messages, user profiles, status updates, and custom widgets.
additional_notes: Integrates smoothly with the rest of Zoho suite. Region routing constraints apply.

one_line_description: Lark is an enterprise collaboration platform combining messaging, calendars, video meetings, and docs into a single workspace.
self_serve_details: Free developer account registration. Custom apps can be created for instant tenant token access.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering IM (chat), documents, calendars, approval workflows, and wiki pages.
additional_notes: Features tenant access tokens (`tenant_access_token`) generated using App ID and App Secret. Highly powerful APIs.

one_line_description: Pumble is a team communication tool designed for real-time discussions, group channels, and file storage.
self_serve_details: Free tier available; users can create apps and generate bot/user tokens instantly via developer console.
api_surface: REST API covering channels, messages, and user lists, resembling Slack's structure.
additional_notes: Open API is designed to mirror Slack's structure closely, simplifying adaptation of existing Slack tools.

one_line_description: Discord is a voice, video, and text communication service used by millions to talk, hang out, and build communities.
self_serve_details: Free Discord Developer Portal allows instant creation of bot applications and client credentials.
api_surface: Broad REST API, WebSocket-based Gateway API (for bots), and RPC capabilities.
additional_notes: Bots use simple token auth: `Authorization: Bot <TOKEN>`. Rate limits are per-route and can be strict.

one_line_description: Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app with a focus on security and speed.
self_serve_details: Bot tokens can be generated instantly for free by chatting with the '@BotFather' bot.
api_surface: HTTP-based Bot API (REST) for bot applications, and MTProto API (TCP/UDP) for client applications.
additional_notes: The Bot API is extremely simple: all commands are sent as HTTP GET/POST queries containing the bot token.

one_line_description: WhatsApp Business API allows medium and large businesses to communicate with customers at scale using automated messaging.
self_serve_details: Free developer setup via Meta for Developers dashboard, offering test phone numbers and sandboxes.
api_surface: Cloud API (REST) hosted by Meta covering templates, messaging, and media, plus Webhooks.
additional_notes: Requires a Meta Developer account and a verified Facebook Business Manager for production scale.

one_line_description: Aircall is a cloud-based call center software that integrates with CRM and helpdesk systems.
self_serve_details: Free 7-day trial provides immediate access to API token keys in admin settings.
api_surface: REST API covering calls, contacts, users, numbers, and tags, with detailed reference documentation.
additional_notes: Authentication uses API ID and API Token passed as HTTP Basic Auth header.

one_line_description: Vonage is a cloud communications platform providing APIs for SMS, voice calls, verification, and video.
self_serve_details: Free developer account with trial credits is available instantly on signup.
api_surface: Broad suite of REST APIs covering messaging, voice, video, and dispatch workflows.
additional_notes: Uses API Key/Secret for simple endpoints, and JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for advanced applications.

one_line_description: Google Ads is an online advertising platform developed by Google, where advertisers bid to display brief advertisements.
self_serve_details: Developer token must be requested and undergoes review; basic access is free but approval is needed.
api_surface: Broad REST-based Google Ads API and Google Ads Query Language (GAQL) with thousands of fields.
buildability_blockers: Requires developer token approval (which can take a few days) and complex OAuth2 setup.
additional_notes: Google Ads API requires a developer token passed in headers along with standard Google OAuth2 access tokens.

one_line_description: Meta Marketing API is a collection of Graph API endpoints that allow businesses to advertise on Facebook, Instagram, and Audience Network.
self_serve_details: Free developer credentials can be generated instantly inside the Meta for Developers portal.
api_surface: Broad Graph API (REST) covering campaigns, ad sets, creatives, custom audiences, and insights.
additional_notes: Requires App Review from Meta to escalate from Development Mode to Production Access.

one_line_description: LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform provides APIs to manage advertising campaigns, lead generation, and reporting.
self_serve_details: Requires applying for the Marketing Developer Platform access, which is self-serve but subject to review.
api_surface: REST API covering ad campaigns, accounts, creatives, metrics, and Lead Gen forms.
buildability_blockers: Requires application review approval in the LinkedIn Developer Portal.
additional_notes: Uses standard OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with client credentials.

one_line_description: GoHighLevel is an all-in-one marketing, sales, and CRM platform designed for agencies to manage customer pipelines and automations.
self_serve_details: Requires a paid agency account ($97/mo+) to access developer portal and generate client credentials.
api_surface: Broad REST API (v2) covering locations, contacts, opportunities, calendars, and templates.
buildability_blockers: Paid account required upfront to access the developer dashboard and APIs.
additional_notes: GoHighLevel recently migrated from legacy location API keys to location-scoped OAuth 2.0 applications.

one_line_description: Mailchimp is a marketing automation platform and email marketing service for managing newsletters and lists.
self_serve_details: Free accounts can generate API keys instantly under Account > Extras > API Keys.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering lists, campaigns, templates, members, and marketing automation.
additional_notes: Mailchimp API endpoints are subdomain-scoped depending on the data center (e.g. `us19.api.mailchimp.com`), which is specified at the end of the API key.

one_line_description: Klaviyo is a marketing automation platform focused on email, SMS, and push notifications for ecommerce businesses.
self_serve_details: Free developer account can be created; public/private API keys are generated instantly in settings.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering profiles, segments, flows, metrics, templates, and campaigns.
additional_notes: Klaviyo uses custom headers `Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key YOUR_KEY` and requires specifying the API version in a header.

one_line_description: Systeme.io is an all-in-one online business software that helps entrepreneurs build sales funnels, host courses, and send emails.
self_serve_details: Free account tier enables instant generation of API keys in Settings > API Keys.
api_surface: REST API covering contacts, campaigns, courses, and sales tracking.
additional_notes: Authentication is handled simply by passing the `x-api-key` header.

one_line_description: Pinterest Developer Platform provides APIs to manage boards, pins, and search integrations.
self_serve_details: Developer account registration is free, providing immediate access to app creation and trial tokens.
api_surface: REST API covering boards, pins, user accounts, and ad marketing tools.
additional_notes: Requires application review to escalate scopes from read-only to full read/write for production users.

one_line_description: Threads API allows users to publish threads, retrieve their media, and manage replies on the Threads app.
self_serve_details: Free developer signup via Meta for Developers dashboard.
api_surface: Graph-based REST API for posting text/images/video and querying thread replies.
additional_notes: Threads API relies on Instagram/Meta Graph framework, using long-lived access tokens.

one_line_description: SendGrid is a cloud-based customer communication platform that offers transactional and marketing email delivery.
self_serve_details: Free plan allows developers to instantly generate API keys inside the SendGrid dashboard.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering mail sending, templates, bounces, suppression lists, and webhooks.
additional_notes: Uses simple Bearer Token header format: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.

one_line_description: Shopify is a leading global ecommerce platform that enables merchants to set up online stores and sell products.
self_serve_details: Free Shopify Partner account lets developers create unlimited development stores to test APIs.
api_surface: Extremely broad REST and GraphQL Admin APIs, Storefront GraphQL API, and Webhooks.
additional_notes: Shopify's GraphQL API is highly recommended over REST due to richer feature support and more efficient queries.

one_line_description: WooCommerce is an open-source, customizable ecommerce plugin built for WordPress sites.
self_serve_details: Free to install. API credentials (Consumer Key and Consumer Secret) can be generated instantly in settings.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering products, orders, customers, and coupons.
additional_notes: Uses standard OAuth 1.0a or Basic Auth over HTTPS. Extremely simple to integrate.

one_line_description: BigCommerce is a SaaS ecommerce platform providing online store creation, hosting, and marketing tools.
self_serve_details: Free developer sandbox account can be registered via the BigCommerce developer portal.
api_surface: Broad REST API (v3) covering catalog, orders, customers, and checkout, alongside a GraphQL Storefront API.
additional_notes: Uses header `X-Auth-Token` for authorization, and requires specifying the store hash in the URL path.

one_line_description: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a cloud-based ecommerce platform that enables brands to create unified buying experiences.
self_serve_details: Requires an active enterprise customer subscription or partner console access to generate API keys.
api_surface: Broad Open Commerce API (OCAPI) and Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI) covering commerce workflows.
buildability_blockers: No free public self-serve developer tier. Requires enterprise credentials.
additional_notes: Highly complex enterprise setup using Salesforce Account Manager for client ID mapping.

one_line_description: Adobe Commerce (formerly Magento) is an open-source, highly customizable ecommerce platform for enterprise businesses.
self_serve_details: Free Magento Open Source edition can be self-hosted, allowing instant API token access.
api_surface: Broad REST and GraphQL APIs covering inventory, cart, checkout, and custom integrations.
additional_notes: Web API supports Admin tokens, Customer tokens, and Guest tokens. Highly developer-flexible.

one_line_description: Squarespace is a website building and hosting platform that offers ecommerce features for online stores.
self_serve_details: Requires a paid Commerce Advanced subscription ($52/mo+) to generate API keys in settings.
api_surface: REST API covering inventory, orders, products, profiles, and transactions.
buildability_blockers: Requires paid Commerce Advanced subscription plan to generate API keys.
additional_notes: No free developer sandbox. API keys must be generated inside a live store panel.

one_line_description: Ecwid is a SaaS tool that allows merchants to easily add an online store to any existing website.
self_serve_details: Free developer account can be registered instantly to generate credentials and test APIs.
api_surface: REST API (Ecwid Custom API) covering products, categories, orders, and customer lists.
additional_notes: Allows custom app creation with immediate client tokens for developer testing.

one_line_description: Gumroad is a simple, direct-to-consumer ecommerce platform for creators to sell digital products, memberships, and physical items.
self_serve_details: Free account registration allows instant API key generation in account settings.
api_surface: REST API covering users, products, sales, resource files, and subscribers.
additional_notes: Offers very straightforward endpoints. Simple OAuth2 support is available.

one_line_description: Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) is a suite of REST APIs that help sellers programmatically access data on inventory, orders, and payments.
self_serve_details: Requires a paid Professional Selling Account ($39.99/mo) and identity verification to register as a developer.
api_surface: Broad suite of REST APIs covering orders, reports, listings, pricing, and fulfillment.
buildability_blockers: Requires active Professional Seller account and approval process to generate credentials.
additional_notes: Relies on AWS Signature Version 4 for query signing and IAM role mappings, making authentication highly complex.

one_line_description: FanBasis is a monetization and creator interaction platform that allows fans to purchase personalized digital experiences.
self_serve_details: Requires account verification and admin approval to activate Developer Mode and obtain credentials.
api_surface: REST API for managing creator profiles, subscriptions, checkouts, and custom creator services.
buildability_blockers: Developer credentials are gated behind creator onboarding and admin approval.
additional_notes: Gated creator-focused checkout service; does not provide open self-serve API access for external developers.

one_line_description: DataForSEO provides structured API data for search engine optimization, marketing campaigns, and competitive research.
self_serve_details: Free developer account with trial credits can be created instantly.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering search engine results (SERP), keywords, backlinks, domains, and business listings.
additional_notes: Uses Basic Access Authentication where credentials are the user's login email and API key.

one_line_description: SE Ranking is an all-in-one SEO platform that offers tools for keyword research, audit, and site rankings tracking.
self_serve_details: API is only accessible to users on paid corporate plans (Enterprise/Plus).
api_surface: REST API covering ranking data, keyword suggestions, audit summaries, and backlink lists.
buildability_blockers: Requires paid corporate/business subscription level to unlock API key settings.
additional_notes: No free developer sandbox. Key generation is gated behind business billing tiers.

one_line_description: Ahrefs is a leading SEO toolset providing backlink audits, keyword research, rank tracking, and competitor analysis.
self_serve_details: API access requires an active paid subscription (Enterprise/Advanced) and consumes credits per query.
api_surface: REST-based Ahrefs API v3 covering domain metrics, search volumes, and backlinks.
buildability_blockers: Requires paid subscription plan upfront to generate API keys in the developer portal.
additional_notes: Very strict usage limits and high credit costs per query. OAuth 2.0 supported for integrations.

one_line_description: MrScraper is a visual web scraping tool that helps users extract data from websites without coding.
self_serve_details: Free account tier enables instant generation of API tokens in settings.
api_surface: REST API to trigger scraper runs, retrieve extracted data, and check run statuses.
additional_notes: Simple integration using standard Bearer Token auth. Great for triggering pre-built web scrapers.

one_line_description: Apify is a cloud platform for web scraping and data extraction, hosting thousands of pre-built scrapers called Actors.
self_serve_details: Free tier with monthly credit allocation allows instant access to API token in settings.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering Actor execution, data stores (datasets, key-value stores), and webhooks.
additional_notes: Provides high developer ergonomics, client libraries, and pre-built integrations. Highly suitable for agents.

one_line_description: Firecrawl converts entire websites into clean, agent-ready markdown or structured JSON for LLMs.
self_serve_details: Free tier with monthly credit allowance provides instant API key on signup.
api_surface: REST API covering page scraping, web crawling, crawl mapping, and structured extraction.
additional_notes: Designed specifically for AI applications. Open-source version can be self-hosted.

one_line_description: Bright Data provides web scraping APIs, proxy networks, and structured datasets for public web data retrieval.
self_serve_details: Free trial balance is available instantly; API keys and proxy tokens are generated via control panel.
api_surface: REST APIs covering web scraping triggers, browser automations, and proxy settings.
additional_notes: Known for proxy rotation. Scraping API keys can be managed under API token section in account dashboard.

one_line_description: Sherlock is an open-source command-line tool used to hunt down social media accounts by username across hundreds of websites.
self_serve_details: Free and open-source command line tool; requires no API signup or authentication keys.
api_surface: CLI tool, no hosted REST API. Can be executed programmatically via terminal wrapper.
additional_notes: No public API server. Must be installed via pip/docker and run locally as a CLI command.

one_line_description: Waterfall.io is a data orchestration platform that enables teams to enrich contact profiles and corporate intelligence.
self_serve_details: Requires contacting sales or obtaining a customized enterprise subscription to request API keys.
api_surface: REST API covering data enrichment endpoints (prospector, search domain, search email).
buildability_blockers: Gated behind sales contact and enterprise agreement setup; no self-serve free sandbox.
additional_notes: Uses header `x-waterfall-api-key` for authentication.

one_line_description: Clay is a spreadsheet-like data orchestration tool that integrates search engines, AI models, and public directories to enrich leads.
self_serve_details: Free tier includes limited monthly credits, providing immediate access to API key under profile developer settings.
api_surface: REST API to manipulate tables, write rows, trigger integrations, and fetch run logs.
additional_notes: Mainly used as a UI-driven database, but the API lets agents read/write data in rows directly.

one_line_description: GitHub is a developer platform for version control, collaboration, CI/CD code building, and repository hosting.
self_serve_details: Free Personal Access Tokens (PAT) can be generated instantly inside developer settings.
api_surface: Extremely broad REST API and GraphQL API covering all repository operations, plus GitHub Actions Webhooks.
additional_notes: Personal Access Tokens (classic or fine-grained) use simple Bearer Token headers and are extremely easy for agents.

one_line_description: Vercel is a cloud platform for frontend developers, providing hosting, serverless functions, and instant deployments.
self_serve_details: Free Hobby account tier allows instant token generation under Account Settings > Tokens.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering deployments, domains, projects, serverless routing, and user profiles.
additional_notes: Requires passing Vercel Team ID parameter in query parameters for team-scoped resources.

one_line_description: Netlify is a web development platform that offers web hosting and automation services for web projects.
self_serve_details: Free tier account enables instant generation of personal access tokens under User Settings > Applications.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering deployments, builds, sites, DNS settings, and forms.
additional_notes: Uses standard Open API definition for its REST endpoints, providing client SDK wrapper libraries.

one_line_description: Cloudflare is a global network company providing CDN, cybersecurity, DNS services, and edge computing.
self_serve_details: Free account tier enables instant API Token generation with fine-grained permissions.
api_surface: Extremely broad REST API covering DNS, workers (serverless), firewall, tunnels, and domains.
additional_notes: Provides high security. Fine-grained tokens are highly recommended over legacy Global API Keys.

one_line_description: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative providing database, auth, file storage, edge functions, and real-time sync.
self_serve_details: Free tier workspace provides immediate database API key (anon/service_role keys) in project dashboard.
api_surface: REST API via PostgREST, GraphQL API, Realtime WebSockets, and Go / JS client libraries.
additional_notes: Provides `anon` key for client side, and `service_role` key bypassing Row Level Security (RLS) for server side.

one_line_description: Neo4j is a graph database management system designed for highly connected data structures and relations.
self_serve_details: Free Neo4j Aura sandbox or desktop edition enables local/cloud instance creation with instant password credentials.
api_surface: Cypher Query Language executed over Bolt protocol (TCP), HTTP REST API, and language drivers.
additional_notes: Bolt protocol (binary) is generally preferred over HTTP for performance-critical queries. Highly suitable for Knowledge Graphs.

one_line_description: Snowflake is a cloud-based data warehousing platform that allows storage, processing, and analytic solutions.
self_serve_details: Free 30-day trial with $400 credits is available instantly on registration.
api_surface: Snowflake SQL API (REST API) for executing queries, database connector drivers, and Snowpark SDK.
additional_notes: SQL API utilizes JSON web tokens (JWT) signed with a developer-generated key pair for authentication.

one_line_description: MongoDB Atlas is a fully-managed cloud database service hosting MongoDB database clusters on AWS, Azure, and GCP.
self_serve_details: Free shared cluster tier includes access to generating project/organization API keys.
api_surface: MongoDB Atlas Administration REST API, MongoDB Data API (HTTPS REST), and standard database wire protocol.
additional_notes: The MongoDB Data API is ideal for serverless / agent architectures as it replaces TCP connection pools with standard HTTPS POST calls.

one_line_description: Datadog is an observability and security platform providing monitoring, analytics, and log management for cloud applications.
self_serve_details: Free 14-day trial provides immediate access to API key generation under Organization Settings > API Keys.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering metrics, dashboards, logs, traces, monitors, and security rules.
additional_notes: Datadog requires passing both an API Key (`DD-API-KEY`) and an Application Key (`DD-APPLICATION-KEY`) in request headers.

one_line_description: Sentry is an developer-first application monitoring platform that identifies code errors, performance issues, and anomalies.
self_serve_details: Free Developer tier enables instant generation of personal auth tokens in settings.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering organizations, projects, issues, events, releases, and releases tracking.
additional_notes: Uses standard HTTP headers `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Permissions can be configured at the token level.

one_line_description: Notion is an all-in-one workspace for note-taking, project management, documents, and wiki databases.
self_serve_details: Free developers portal allows instant generation of 'Internal Integrations' tokens.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering databases, pages, blocks, search, and user profiles.
additional_notes: Notion requires specifying `Notion-Version` in headers to handle API version routing. Database pages can be updated block-by-block.

one_line_description: Airtable is a cloud-based hybrid spreadsheet-database platform that helps teams organize projects, workflows, and databases.
self_serve_details: Free account tier allows instant creation of Personal Access Tokens (PATs) under developer settings.
api_surface: REST API covering tables, records, fields, views, user collaboration, and Webhooks.
additional_notes: Airtable deprecated legacy API keys in February 2024. All connections must now use PATs or OAuth 2.0.

one_line_description: Linear is a developer-focused issue tracking and project management tool designed for fast, high-performance product building.
self_serve_details: Free account tier allows instant generation of Personal Access Tokens (PATs) inside profile settings.
api_surface: Comprehensive GraphQL API covering issues, cycles, projects, users, and teams, alongside Webhooks.
additional_notes: GraphQL API is extremely rich, serving as the same API behind Linear's own web and desktop clients.

one_line_description: Jira is a software tool developed by Atlassian, used for bug tracking, issue tracking, and agile project management.
self_serve_details: Free Atlassian Developer account setup allows generating API Tokens in security settings.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering issues, sprints, boards, projects, workflow rules, and webhooks.
additional_notes: Authentication typically uses Basic Auth with the user's email address and the generated API Token.

one_line_description: Asana is a mobile and web-based workspace application designed to help teams organize, track, and manage their work.
self_serve_details: Free Developer Console sandbox allows instant Personal Access Token generation in developer portal.
api_surface: REST API covering tasks, projects, workspaces, stories, and portfolio management.
additional_notes: Uses standard Bearer Token format. Rates are dynamically adjusted depending on workspace sizes.

one_line_description: Monday.com is a cloud-based Work OS that allows teams to build custom workflow applications to run project pipelines.
self_serve_details: Free developer sandbox account can be created to build apps and generate API keys.
api_surface: Comprehensive GraphQL API covering boards, items, columns, groups, updates, and users.
additional_notes: GraphQL-first Work OS. All request queries must target the `/v2` endpoint using `Authorization: YOUR_KEY` header.

one_line_description: ClickUp is an all-in-one productivity platform designed to manage tasks, docs, goals, reminders, and chats.
self_serve_details: Free tier enables instant Personal API key generation under user settings profile page.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering workspaces, spaces, lists, tasks, members, and custom attributes.
additional_notes: Uses query or header parameter `Authorization` containing the generated API token.

one_line_description: Coda is a collaborative document editor that integrates spreadsheets, text fields, and databases into a single canvas.
self_serve_details: Free account tier allows generating API keys instantly under Account Settings > Developer.
api_surface: REST API covering Coda docs, tables, rows, columns, formulas, and publishing properties.
additional_notes: Supports robust webhooks. The Coda Packs API allows developers to write custom serverless integrations.

one_line_description: Smartsheet is a software-as-a-service application for collaboration and work management, structured as grids.
self_serve_details: Free developer account can be requested online, or free trials provide token generation under account profile.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering sheets, rows, files, comments, shares, and automated triggers.
additional_notes: Standard Bearer Token format: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`. Client SDKs available in multiple languages.

one_line_description: Harvest is a cloud-based time tracking and invoicing software designed for professional services and freelancers.
self_serve_details: Free developer account can be requested, or standard workspaces generate API keys instantly.
api_surface: REST API covering timesheet entries, projects, clients, tasks, invoices, and user tracking.
additional_notes: Harvest API requires passing both a Bearer Token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) and a Harvest Account ID header (`Harvest-Account-Id`).

one_line_description: Stripe is a suite of APIs powering online payment processing and commerce solutions for internet businesses.
self_serve_details: Free developer account sandbox is created instantly on sign up to obtain API keys.
api_surface: Extremely broad REST API covering charges, checkout sessions, billing subscriptions, and payouts.
additional_notes: Gold standard of API design. Test mode API keys (`sk_test_...`) work instantly without active business validation.

one_line_description: Plaid is a financial services company that builds connection APIs connecting consumer bank accounts to financial apps.
self_serve_details: Free Sandbox environment provides instant access to mock bank connections and API keys.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering transactions, balances, identity verification, investments, and auth.
additional_notes: Authentication requires passing `client_id` and `secret` in JSON request payloads rather than standard headers.

one_line_description: Binance is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange platform supporting spot, futures, and margin trading.
self_serve_details: Free developer account enables generating API keys instantly inside API management console.
api_surface: Broad REST API and high-performance WebSockets streams for market data and trading execution.
additional_notes: Private endpoints require signing request payloads using HMAC-SHA256 with a developer's secret key.

one_line_description: Paygent is an API cost metering, optimization, and gating tool built for generative AI developers.
self_serve_details: Free account sign up at paygent.to provides instant API key generation in developer dashboard.
api_surface: Simple REST API covering AI usage tracks, spend limits, gating, and transaction credits.
additional_notes: Uses simple Bearer Token header format (`pg_live_...`). Designed specifically for AI pipeline billing management.

one_line_description: iPayX Protocol is an automated financial FX auditing and settlement engine designed for cross-border currency trades.
self_serve_details: Free developer portal registration provides instant sandbox API key access.
api_surface: REST API covering FX rates auditing, deal validation, and settlement tracking, with MCP connector support.
additional_notes: Specifically highlights native MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for connecting FX engines to AI agents.

one_line_description: QuickBooks is an accounting software package developed by Intuit, geared mainly toward small and medium-sized businesses.
self_serve_details: Intuit Developer Portal is free to register and provides instant sandbox accounts and credentials.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering invoices, customers, vendors, payments, tax calculations, and accounts.
additional_notes: Requires full OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Sandbox tokens are valid for testing instantly.

one_line_description: Xero is a cloud-based accounting software platform for small and medium-sized businesses.
self_serve_details: Free Xero Developer account registration provides immediate sandbox access and app keys.
api_surface: Broad REST API covering invoices, bank transactions, payroll, tax rates, and reports.
additional_notes: Xero transitioned to OAuth 2.0. Standard authorization code flow requires tenant matching using `Xero-Tenant-Id` header.

one_line_description: Brex is a financial technology company offering corporate credit cards, cash management accounts, and expense tracking.
self_serve_details: Brex accounts can generate User Tokens instantly via the developer settings console.
api_surface: REST API covering expenses, cash transfers, card management, team settings, and vendors.
additional_notes: Provides high developer ergonomics. Single-tenant scripts use User Tokens, while third-party apps use OAuth 2.0.

one_line_description: Ramp is a finance automation platform providing corporate cards, expense management, and bill payments.
self_serve_details: Ramp developers can register apps instantly and generate credentials via their developer settings.
api_surface: REST API covering card management, physical card shipping, expenses, transactions, and bill pays.
additional_notes: Highly documented. Requires OAuth 2.0 or Client Credentials token mapping.

one_line_description: PitchBook provides private and public equity data, funding round details, and research intelligence APIs.
self_serve_details: Requires custom enterprise data agreement; API access must be negotiated with sales teams.
api_surface: REST API and bulk data pipelines covering VC funding, M&A transactions, and private company profiles.
buildability_blockers: Gated behind expensive enterprise sales contracts; no developer sandbox available.
additional_notes: Highly restricted institutional financial database.

one_line_description: NotebookLM is Google's AI-powered notebook tool that synthesizes document uploads into summary audio and text.
self_serve_details: No public developer API is offered for NotebookLM directly today; features must be replicated using Vertex AI.
api_surface: None. No public API developer documentation exists for the NotebookLM web application.
buildability_blockers: No public developer API available for NotebookLM.
additional_notes: A closed consumer application. Developers looking for similar features must build custom setups using Gemini API / Vertex AI.

one_line_description: Otter.ai is an AI-powered transcription service that takes real-time notes and generates summaries from meetings and audio.
self_serve_details: API is gated behind enterprise licensing agreements; no public self-serve portal.
api_surface: REST API and WebSocket streams for real-time transcription sync, though undocumented.
buildability_blockers: No public, self-serve developer API portal; API keys are enterprise/partner restricted.
additional_notes: Community integrations exist using unofficial session cookies/tokens, but lack official developer support.

one_line_description: Fathom is a free Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet app that records, transcribes, and highlights key moments in video calls.
self_serve_details: Free developer application registration can be requested via Fathom Developer Portal.
api_surface: REST API covering meeting recordings, transcript highlights, and automated sync summaries.
additional_notes: Allows simple OAuth flow for integrating transcript delivery directly into CRMs and workflows.

one_line_description: Consensus is a search engine that uses AI to extract and summarize findings from scientific research papers.
self_serve_details: API is currently in closed beta; developers must request access via an application form.
api_surface: REST API to perform academic searches and retrieve citation metadata and summaries.
buildability_blockers: Closed beta application requirement; API access is not self-serve.
additional_notes: Highly requested OAuth flow. Designed for research indexing.

one_line_description: Reducto is an AI-powered document ingestion API that converts PDFs, images, and slides into clean layout-aware Markdown.
self_serve_details: Free trial credits provided instantly upon creating an account, with API keys generated in settings.
api_surface: Simple REST API covering layout-aware parsing, tabular extraction, and document chunking.
additional_notes: Uses simple Bearer Token header format. Extremely useful tool for parsing complex PDF tables for AI agents.

one_line_description: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer developed by Cognition, capable of building and deploying software.
self_serve_details: Developer API access requires active subscription tier and developer portal access registration.
api_surface: REST API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers enabling coordination with Devin workspaces.
buildability_blockers: Gated developer dashboard access and paid customer tier required.
additional_notes: Supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) to allow tools and scripts to interact directly with Devin's workspace shell.

one_line_description: Higgsfield is a generative AI video platform that enables users to create and edit cinematic content from text prompts.
self_serve_details: Free CLI installation provides immediate access to account authentication via login browser flow.
api_surface: Command Line Interface (CLI) tool wrapping video generation model triggers and file uploads.
additional_notes: The CLI handles session OAuth redirection automatically, making it easy to trigger video generation from local agents.

one_line_description: Mermaid CLI is a command-line tool that renders text definitions of diagrams (charts, flows) into SVG, PNG, or PDF images.
self_serve_details: Free and open-source CLI utility; requires no account signup or authentication.
api_surface: Command Line Interface (CLI) based on Puppeteer, no hosted REST API.
additional_notes: Ideal for agent integration. Agents can run it locally: `mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.png`.

one_line_description: TranscriptAPI.com is a developer API for extracting raw transcripts and closed captions from YouTube video URLs.
self_serve_details: Free tier with 100 free monthly credits provides instant API key in dashboard on signup.
api_surface: Simple REST API covering video metadata, transcript extraction, and language translations.
additional_notes: Uses header `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Very simple and agent-friendly.

one_line_description: Grain is an AI meeting recording tool that captures video, transcribes discussions, and generates summaries for sales teams.
self_serve_details: Free account sign up provides instant access to developer settings to register OAuth applications.
api_surface: REST API covering calls, users, workspaces, clips, and highlights, plus Webhooks.
additional_notes: Excellent webhook integration for receiving raw audio clips and transcript text objects instantly.
